Subject: 2 ideas for [BUSINESS]’s [VERIFIED OPPORTUNITY]

Hi — I was researching [CATEGORY] businesses and noticed [ONE VERIFIED FACT].

I think there’s a specific customer-growth opportunity around: “[BUSINESS-SPECIFIC ANGLE]”

I can turn that into ready-to-use Google/social posts, customer follow-ups, genuine review-request copy, FAQs, one promotional email and a 30-day use calendar.

Same-Day Customer Growth Pack: $150 flat, no subscription.

I already drafted two [BUSINESS]-specific examples. Want me to send them?

Hi — following up on the idea I sent for [BUSINESS]. If the full package isn’t useful yet, I can send the two business-specific samples first so you can judge the quality before deciding. No obligation.
Last note from me — I’ll close the loop unless you’d like the two [BUSINESS]-specific examples. If you’d rather not receive future outreach, just reply “no thanks” and I’ll suppress the contact.

Absolutely — here are the two samples. If the direction fits, I can complete the full Same-Day Customer Growth Pack: customized campaign angle, Google/social posts, FAQs, customer/estimate follow-ups, genuine review-request copy, one promotional email, CTA variants and a 30-day use calendar. Starter pack: $150 flat, no subscription.

The starter pack is $150 flat with no subscription. It includes the customized campaign angle, ready-to-publish posts, customer/estimate follow-ups, genuine review-request copy, FAQs, one promotional email, CTA variants and a 30-day use calendar. I don’t guarantee a specific number of leads or revenue; the deliverable is the completed business-specific marketing and follow-up system.
No problem. I’ll leave it here and won’t keep following up. If [VERIFIED OPPORTUNITY] becomes a priority later, you can reply to this thread and I can pick it back up.

Makes sense. I’m not trying to replace your agency or existing marketing. This is a small fixed-scope pack built around one current offer/service opportunity — useful as an extra campaign, follow-up sequence, or customer-education asset. If that’s not useful, no problem and I’ll close the loop.

No — I don’t guarantee leads, rankings, bookings or revenue. What I can guarantee is the agreed deliverable: a completed, customized pack based on your approved facts and offer, with no fabricated testimonials or performance claims.

Great — I’ll send the short intake first so I use only your approved service details, contact information and offer terms. Once payment is confirmed, I’ll complete the agreed pack and send the finished copy in one handoff.
